To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the introduction of source separation for recycling and landfill gas recovery for energy recovery can contribute to the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions in the existing waste management in Phuket, Thailand.

the application of LCA in waste management planning can provide a comprehensive understanding of waste treatment systems in terms of environmental impact and can support the decision-making for planning and optimizing integrated solid waste management.

the application of LCA to compare the GWP of four different scenarios of IWMSs in Phuket has shown that scenario 4 (combining source separation for recycling and anaerobic digestion) is the best option, contributing GWP 415 kg CO 2  eq. per ton of Phuket municipal solid waste treated, whereas the base scenario contributes GWP 1006  kg CO 2 eq.
